game_title: Syntax Sweep – Buried Temple Steps Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps, steps of a half-buried temple: the camel trader must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Syntax Sweep: Spot and fix syntax errors such as missing colons or brackets before the program runs.
theme: Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps: steps of a half-buried temple
core_gameplay_loop: In Buried Temple Steps, repeat each round: Spot and fix syntax errors such as missing colons or brackets before the program runs. Each round, sandstorms strike the camel pen, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the syntax_errors value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the camel pen from sandstorms in Buried Temple Steps: keep the syntax_errors meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: syntax_errors drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 3 (intro tier): Syntax Sweep
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Syntax Sweep' (Week 9 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Buried Temple Steps'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how syntax_errors changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sandstorms in Buried Temple Steps.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while syntax_errors > 0.
